description: RTV-65 labelled verdict eval gold set. Each case is a control (by control-library id) + the evidence excerpts retrieved for it + the expected verdict a human assessor would give. Two consumers: (1) tests/unittest/verdictEval.test.js — the DETERMINISTIC CI gate (gold-set validity + the §5 guardrail: empty evidence → insufficient_evidence, no model); (2) scripts/evaluateVerdicts.js — the LLM verdict BENCHMARK (runs the real judge, scores accuracy/precision/recall). The benchmark needs a live model, so it runs manually/scheduled (like scripts/evaluate.js), not per-push.

evidence.snippet: The Provider maintains ICT security measures aligned with ISO 27001 (certificate valid 2024–2027) and provides a SOC 2 Type II report covering security, availability and confidentiality.
The provider says its security is 'best effort' and industry standard, but provides no certification, standard, or independent report.
A business continuity plan and disaster-recovery arrangements are maintained, with a documented 4-hour RTO and annual resilience testing.
The agreement explicitly contains no business continuity or disaster-recovery obligations; the provider disclaims any availability commitment.
The Financial Entity has an unrestricted right to audit and on-site inspection, and may organise pooled audits with other financial entities.
Audits are limited to a single remote document review per year, scheduled at the provider's discretion; on-site inspection is not permitted.
On termination the Provider gives exit assistance during a transition period, including return and deletion of data and support for data portability.
There is no exit strategy or exit plan; the contract auto-renews indefinitely with no ability to transition to an alternative provider.
Service levels: 99.9% availability, quantitative and qualitative performance targets, measured and reviewed monthly.
The service will be provided 'to a generally accepted standard'; no quantitative service-level targets are specified.
The data-processing agreement guarantees the availability, authenticity, integrity and confidentiality of personal data processed under the arrangement.
Data is processed and stored only in the EU (Ireland and Frankfurt regions); no processing or transfer outside the EEA.
The Provider shall provide assistance in the case of an ICT incident and notify the Financial Entity of incidents within 24 hours.
The Provider agrees to fully cooperate with the competent authorities and any resolution authorities, including regulatory cooperation and information access.
The Financial Entity may terminate for material breach and on a 30-day notice period; termination rights are unrestricted.
Subcontracting requires prior notification of changes to subprocessors, and the Financial Entity retains the right to object to any material subcontracting change.
Due diligence and a risk assessment prior to contracting were completed, including a check for conflicts of interest and an assessment of subcontracting.
Ongoing monitoring is performed through quarterly service-performance reviews measuring performance against agreed metrics.
A full description of the services and the scope of services, listing all functions to be provided, is set out in Schedule A.
The service is a read-only public status dashboard that stores and processes no customer or personal data whatsoever.
